package composeconfig

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListComposeConfigs lists compose configs with pagination.
type ListComposeConfigs struct {
	ComposeConfigs     repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	ComposeConfigTechs repository.ComposeConfigTechRepository
}

// Handle returns compose configs list.
func (uc ListComposeConfigs) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.ComposeConfigFilters) ([]domain.ComposeConfig, map[string][]int, int, error) {
	configs, total, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.List(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, 0, err
	}
	techIDs := map[string][]int{}
	if uc.ComposeConfigTechs != nil {
		for _, cfg := range configs {
			ids, err := uc.ComposeConfigTechs.ListTechIDs(ctx, cfg.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, 0, err
			}
			techIDs[cfg.ID] = ids
		}
	}
	return configs, techIDs, total, nil
}
